data.finding: SLC38A9 is a component of the lysosomal amino-acid sensing machinery controlling mTORC1.
data.abstract_excerpt: Cell growth and proliferation are tightly linked to nutrient availability. The mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) integrates the presence of growth factors, energy levels, glucose and amino acids to modulate metabolic status and cellular responses. mTORC1 is activated at the surface of lysosomes by the RAG GTPases and the Ragulator complex through a not fully understood mechanism monitoring amino acid availability in the lysosomal lumen and involving the vacuolar H(+)-ATPase.

extracted_findings.effect: SLC38A9 is a lysosomal amino-acid (arginine) transporter/sensor component that controls mTORC1
